names.plain: Bony seam below the ear canal

gloss: A seam between two parts of the temporal bone; the nerve trunk lies a few millimetres from it, just below.
role: Surgeons find the nerve trunk a few millimetres below a seam in the bone below the ear canal.
matters: The tympanomastoid suture is a bony landmark for the trunk: in cadavers and live patients the closest distance was about 2 mm, and one protocol places the nerve approximately 2 mm inferior to the suture. Reported distances vary with the reference point used.
